title: Blue and Gold Faces 2026
description: A face painting initiative during the Big Match season and Rugby Season, enhancing school spirit through on-site face painting at match venues and classroom visits.

title: ArtWorks 2026
description: ArtWorks is the Royal College Art Circle's year-round service initiative, running from January to November 2026.

title: Chithra Akura 2026
description: A multi-phase project including the outdoor creations board, a dedicated website to educate students about the art syllabus and a social media poster series.

title: Legacy 2026
description: An educational field visit program taking students from Grades 8-12 to art galleries and museums and art exhibitions.

title: O/L Art Seminar Series 2026
description: This is an educational project organized by the Royal College Art Circle in collaboration with the Royal College Upper Middle Section. It is designed to support Grade 11 students as they prepare for the G.C.E. Ordinary Level Art examination.

title: Colour 2026
description: Through Colour'26, the Art Circle hopes to give student artworks a lasting place within Royal College while adding artistic value to the school's administrative spaces.
